title: Beginner: how a car moves
summary: Follow energy from fuel to tarmac: what the engine does, how the gearbox and differential shape its output, and how the tyres finally push the car along.

title: Inside the engine
summary: Take the combustion engine apart one system at a time — the moving parts, how fuel and spark are timed, and how heat and friction are kept under control.

title: Stopping, steering and grip
summary: Understand the systems that keep a car under control: hydraulic brakes and ABS, steering, suspension and the small contact patches that do all the work.
